title: PhyDrawGen：基于物理规律的图表生成
summary: PhyDrawGen是一个神经符号管道，从自然语言生成物理图表。它利用大语言模型提取场景图，通过确定性求解器转换为平面直线图，并用微调的Qwen-VL模型迭代修正约束违反。在1449个物理问题基准上，其物理准确性显著优于GPT-5-image等模型。
summary_en: PhyDrawGen is a neuro-symbolic pipeline that generates physics diagrams from natural language. It uses an LLM to extract a scene graph, a deterministic solver to convert it into a planar straight-line graph, and a fine-tuned Qwen-VL model to iteratively correct constraint violations. It significantly outperforms GPT-5-image on a benchmark of 1,449 physics problems.
